headline: Legislature passes central government budget in third reading... Fu Kun-chi: I have given my all, just hoping people can live well
summary: Taiwan's Legislative Yuan passed the 115th-year central government budget in third reading, with a final cut of about NT$48 billion, or 1.689%. Negotiations cut more than 1,700 items to 40 to 50.
why: The central government budget sets state spending and revenue plans, which influence fiscal policy and public investment in Taiwan.
